trecho.0: Architecture that comments on painting (a stained-glass pyramid?) and plays with the symbolism of the social pyramid, turning it inside out, upside down (perhaps through the teaching received from the great Joaquim Torres Garcia, in his map of the Americas, an image so dear to the artist). To this line of thought, it seems, belongs his Expressosionista, a superimposition of metal grids (how can one not recall “Malhas da Liberdade” or the “Através” of Cildo Meireles, of whom he is a contemporary) that imprison a small photograph of a truck transporting Jews. The centralized image, with all the appeal that the theme carries, becomes there a simple annotation. The question shifts to the structure of grids, a topological space, a base for receiving other image-informations. The expresso there comments on a state of things, a possible configuration in the relations of power. The photograph is one among others (one among other imprisonments). Commentary-constructions that
